text: Class will be open only with minimum of 8 students. Summer classes: mid June thru mid September, students may enroll any time. Curriculum 1-week Short-term Chinese Language Training Class Monday 8:10 - 9:30 Screening Test 9:50-11:20 Comprehensive Chinese 13:30- 16:00 Language Practice (Listening oriented) Tuesday 8:10 - 9:30 Comprehensive Chinese 9:50-11:20 Comprehensive Chinese 13:30- 16:00 Language Practice*(Speaking oriented) Wednesday 8:10 - 9:30 Spoken Chinese 9:50-11:20 Listening Comprehension 13:30- 16:00 Special Topics ** Thursday 8:10 - 9:30 Comprehensive Chinese 9:50-11:20 Comprehensive Chinese 13:30- 16:00 Language Practice (Listening oriented) Friday 8:10 - 9:30 Spoken Chinese 9:50-11:20 Listening Comprehension 13:30- 16:00 Language Practice*(Speaking oriented) * Language Practice Class includes Situation Language Practice, Daily Chinese, Listening Practice, etc. ** Special Topics include Chinese Culture, Taiqi Boxing, Folk Custom, Calligraphy, Drama, Martial Arts, History, Economy, Politics, Geography, Painting, etc.
